title: Either side ending the call is reported to the other with its own code and reason
provenance: Synthetic. Close codes and reasons are chosen for this fixture, not observed on a real call.
note: v3 treats an upstream close of 1000 as the session completing and anything else as a transport loss to reconnect, so the code the proxy forwards decides whether the client retries. The codex-rs writer sends session.close and then closes without an application code; the second case here deliberately supplies one, because the proxy also serves clients that do, and a relay that rewrites every hang-up to 1000 is not transparent.
